verdict.rationale: PlayCanvas documents an official Editor MCP Server that connects AI assistants to an open Editor session, modifies project data and verifies results via the viewport or a running app (playcanvas-docs-6, playcanvas-docs-34). A runtime probe independently confirms it is npm-published as @playcanvas/editor-mcp-server 0.7.1 under the official GitHub org and actively maintained (playcanvas-probe-rt-1, playcanvas-probe-3). Missing for 10: hands-on community corroboration of agent connection in practice, and detail on tool coverage beyond the Editor session (version 0.7.x suggests pre-1.0 maturity).
